# Data sources and flow {#sec-sources}

DP-Next collects data from multiple sources, including clinical examinations,
biological samples, questionnaires, and electronic tools. Data originates from
participants, healthcare personnel and Danish national register data. Data from
participants and healthcare personnel will be collected through REDCap and
transferred for storage on secure servers at GenomeDK. Data from Danish register
data are stored on Statistics Denmark (DST). For subsequent analysis, data from
GenomeDK can be uploaded to DST.

```{mermaid}
%%| label: dataflow
%%| fig-cap: >-
%%|   Diagram showing a basic overview of DP-Next, its anticipated users, and
%%|   data providers.
%%| fig-width: 100%

flowchart TD
  Healthprof(["<b>Healthcare personnel</b><br><i>[person]</i><br>working with the participants, collecting data and analysis of samples."])
  Participant(["<b>Participant</b><br><i>[person]</i><br>participating in the study, answering questionnaires and participating in clinical examinations."])
  Datamanager(["<b>Data Manager</b><br><i>[person]</i><br>working with retrieval and storage of data."])
  Researcher(["<b>Researcher</b><br><i>[person]</i><br>interested in doing additional analysis of existing data."])

  DP-Next[["<b>DP-Next</b><br><i>[system]</i><br>the DP-Next system will be comprised of REDCap and GenomeDK.<br>REDCap receives raw data; GenomeDK stores cleaned data."]]
  DS[["<b>Denmark Statistics</b><br><i>[system]</i><br>Closed analysis tool where data from DP-Next can be uploaded and compared with Danish register data."]]
  DP[["<b>Data Collectors</b><br><i>[systems]</i><br>Questionnaire, smartwatch, CGM, clinical examinations and biological samples."]]

  DP-Next:::system
  DP:::external
  DS:::external
  Healthprof --> DP
  Participant --> DP
  Datamanager --> DP
  DP --> DP-Next
  Researcher --> DP-Next
  DP-Next --> DS
  Researcher --> DS

  classDef system stroke-width:4pt
  classDef external fill:lightgrey
```
